text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My skin's been feeling rough lately, and I think it must be because of all the tea I've been drinking. I've probably had too much caffeine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But that's why I want to go strawberry picking! Let's go and replenish my vitamins!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If my skin continues to get worse… Nooo, I don't want to think about it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl seems to be worried about the condition of her skin, so I get started on looking up some good places to go strawberry picking with her.
